result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I did not write new tests for the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` or `build-gradle.js` cases, so those are unchecked beyond the pattern edits.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, so I changed them to `(html|htm|xhtml)`. `.htm` pages are now covered, and `.html` and `.xhtml` match as before.
- **Generated `.xml` and `.js` files:** the `<doc>` XML rule and the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule had patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. The content patterns still decide which files land in the generated scope, so ordinary hand-written `.js`, `.xml` and `.htm` files stay out.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the build-and-deployment rule `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is still caught by the existing `.*[.]gradle` rule.

Nothing is committed.
